videos.caption: #donaldtrump #maga #midterms #usa #oil  Cross fact-check by ChatGPT: ⚠️ hqnewsnow — Unverifiable prediction and sweeping “every American” claim; current data show cooling inflation but persistently poor housing affordability. *(Source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics CPI releases; Atlanta Fed Home Ownership Affordability Monitor)* ⚠️ allwhichiam — Incorrect universal claim; BLS and EIA data show some prices have fallen (e.g., used cars from 2022 peaks, consumer electronics, gasoline vs 2022 high), so not “literally everything” rose since Trump took office. *(Source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics CPI; U.S. Energy Information Administration; AAA Gas Prices)* ⚠️ geewizzguys — Misinterpretation: Jan 2021 gas (~$2.40) and oil (~$52) were well below 2022 peaks (gas >$5, oil ~$120) that occurred under Biden, so the correction does not “make Biden’s side look better.” *(Source: U.S. Energy Information Administration gasoline and WTI price series; AAA national gas-price peak June 2022)* ✅ grok — Accurate: Jan 2021 averages were about $2.40/gal for regular gas and ~$52 WTI, 2022 peaks exceeded $5/gal and ~$120/barrel under Biden, and Trump’s second term began in 2025. *(Source: U.S. Energy Information Administration; AAA Gas Prices; National Archives presidential inauguration dates)*
